english: A crude grappling hook for the crossbow, with the shortest reach of the three. With the crossbow that fired it in hand, hold attack to reel in and aim to reel out. Jump to let go.\n\nWhile hanging you can switch to any other weapon or tool and use it normally. The rope holds its length until you switch back to that crossbow.

A forged iron grappling hook for the crossbow that reaches farther than the scrap hook. With the crossbow that fired it in hand, hold attack to reel in and aim to reel out. Jump to let go.\n\nWhile hanging you can switch to any other weapon or tool and use it normally. The rope holds its length until you switch back to that crossbow.

A steel grappling hook for the crossbow, with the longest reach of the three. With the crossbow that fired it in hand, hold attack to reel in and aim to reel out. Jump to let go.\n\nWhile hanging you can switch to any other weapon or tool and use it normally. The rope holds its length until you switch back to that crossbow.
